pg.s1: Choose an amount and how often — say, $10 every week.
pg.s2: The exchange buys bitcoin on schedule — on your own account.
pg.s3: You watch it grow in the app. The money stays on your exchange the whole time.
how.lead: From the market to your decision in four steps. The money stays yours the whole time.
how.s1.p: It scans the market every minute and tests hundreds of rules on history every night.
how.s2.p: Only a signal that survived history, the exam and the risk shield reaches you.
how.s3.p: Entry, stop, target and the reason, in plain words. No hidden trades.
how.s4.p: Repeat the trade on your own exchange account, or just watch on demo. The money is always yours.
start.money.p: The exchange shares part of its own fee with us for users who came through our invitation. Your fees and terms stay the same.
earn.f1: You trade on your own account
earn.f2: The exchange takes its usual fee
earn.f3: and shares part of it with CRYPTO NOVA
live.real: Live · spot part at Binance prices · {ago}
